n1.speaker: patel
n1.text: Mrs Thompson, thanks for coming. I'm afraid Ryan's been late four times this term.

translations.fa: خانم تامپسون، ممنون که اومدید. متأسفانه رایان این ترم چهار بار دیر اومده.

branches.suggestion: I'm sorry — I didn't know. I'll speak to him tonight.
branches.suggestionFa: متأسفم — خبر نداشتم. امشب باهاش حرف می‌زنم.

branches.suggestion: Four times? He leaves the house on time!
branches.suggestionFa: چهار بار؟ سر وقت از خونه میره!

n2.speaker: patel
n2.text: He says the bus is late, but some friends say he stops at the chicken shop.

translations.fa: می‌گه اتوبوس دیر میاد، ولی بعضی از دوستاش می‌گن جلوی مرغ‌سوخاری‌فروشی وایمیسه.

branches.suggestion: The chicken shop! At eight in the morning?
That explains why he never eats breakfast.
branches.suggestionFa: این توضیح می‌ده چرا هیچ‌وقت صبحونه نمی‌خوره.

n3.speaker: patel
n3.text: Ha — teenagers. Shall we agree a plan? Maybe he could text you when he arrives.

translations.fa: ها — نوجوون‌ها. یه برنامه توافق کنیم؟ شاید وقتی رسید بهتون پیام بده.

branches.suggestion: Good idea. I'll make sure he does.
branches.suggestionFa: فکر خوبیه. مطمئن میشم این کار را بکنه.

branches.suggestion: His dad drives the bus — I'll ask Tom to check!
branches.suggestionFa: باباش رانندهٔ اتوبوسه — از تام می‌خوام بررسی کنه!

n4.speaker: patel
n4.text: Thank you. Otherwise, he's doing well. His maths is excellent.

translations.fa: ممنون. جدا از این، خوب پیش میره. ریاضیش عالیه.

branches.suggestion: That's good to hear. What about English?
He gets that from his grandad.

n5.speaker: patel
n5.text: English is fine, but he rushes his essays. Reading at home would help.

translations.fa: انگلیسیش خوبه، ولی انشاهاش را با عجله می‌نویسه. کتاب خوندن تو خونه کمک می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: He only reads football news. Does that count?
branches.suggestionFa: فقط اخبار فوتبال می‌خونه. حساب میشه؟

branches.suggestion: I'll get him a library card.

n6.speaker: patel
n6.text: Anything is better than nothing! Football biographies are a good start. Do you have any questions?

translations.fa: هر چیزی بهتر از هیچیه! زندگی‌نامه‌های فوتبالی شروع خوبیه. سؤالی دارید؟

branches.suggestion: How's he getting on with his friends?
Is he ready for his GCSEs?

cultureNote.en: Pupils study for GCSEs in Years 10 and 11 and sit the exams at sixteen.
cultureNote.fa: دانش‌آموزان در سال‌های ۱۰ و ۱۱ برای GCSE درس می‌خوانند و در ۱۶ سالگی امتحان می‌دهند.

n7.speaker: patel
n7.text: He's very popular — a bit too chatty in lessons, if anything! He's thinking about engineering.

translations.fa: خیلی محبوبه — اگه چیزی باشه، سر کلاس یه کم زیادی پرحرفه! داره به مهندسی فکر می‌کنه.

branches.suggestion: That's wonderful. He loves building things.

n8.speaker: patel
n8.text: He's shy about it, I think. Encourage him — physics and maths would keep that door open.

translations.fa: فکر کنم دربارش خجالت می‌کشه. تشویقش کنید — فیزیک و ریاضی اون در را باز نگه می‌داره.

branches.suggestion: I will. Thank you, Mrs Patel.
Thanks so much — this has been really helpful.

n9.speaker: patel
n9.text: My pleasure. And tell him: no more chicken before registration!

translations.fa: خواهش می‌کنم. و بهش بگید: دیگه مرغ قبل از حضورغیاب نه!
